title: Two groups arranged differently say it in one line
goal: When you pick two groups that are arranged in different ways, the Layout section ends in a five line explanation of what a pick there will do. Every other case in that section now says its piece in a row or one short line, so this is the last paragraph left in it. Say the same thing in one line.
notes: ContentsSelection.flowsDifferNote, rendered at the foot of PlacementInspector.contentRows. Left deliberately long on 2026-09-06 when the rest of the section was cut (task layout-stops-lecturing-and-starts-fitting) because a mixed arrangement is genuinely confusing and over-explaining seemed the safer error. Measure it the same way: Scripts/playtest/layout-fits-walk.json reads dock section offsets back, and contents-for-several-walk.json already reaches the state.
acceptance: Picking two groups with different arrangements ends the Layout section in one line, not five
The fact that a pick reaches every picked group is still said somewhere on screen
The section is measurably shorter in that state than it is today
